error: Grey pill backgrounds behind every paragraph in the reference book reader
fix: Renamed the paragraph wrapper to .dseg; grep styles.css for a class name before reusing it
root_cause: Paragraph wrappers used class .seg, which is already the segmented-control style (inline-flex, grey background, padding)

detail: Two copies of the app stacked in the window after hot reloads (dev only); console: You are calling ReactDOMClient.createRoot() on a container that has already been passed to createRoot()
error: Two copies of the app stacked in the window after hot reloads (dev only); console: You are calling ReactDOMClient.createRoot() on a container that has already been passed to createRoot()
fix: Moved hideSplash to src/splash.ts so nothing imports main.tsx; keep the entry point free of exports
root_cause: main.tsx exported hideSplash, which App.tsx imported, so an HMR update re-ran the entry point and mounted a second root into #root; scrollIntoView (Ask) then scrolled the hidden-overflow body to reveal it

error: Unhandled rejection: dialog.confirm not allowed. Command not found (deleting a journal entry or plan did nothing)
fix: confirmDelete() in src/ui.tsx uses the plugin's confirm(), which goes through plugin:dialog|message (dialog:allow-message is already granted); every delete uses it
root_cause: window.confirm inside the Tauri webview calls a dialog.confirm command that tauri-plugin-dialog 2.7 does not have, so the promise rejects and the delete never runs
